faq.headline: Frequent questions.
faq.q1: Do I need to hold crypto to accept it?
faq.a1: Nope. Buyers pay in any of 15+ supported coins, and you decide what you keep — hold the original coin, or auto-convert to USDC or USDT, settled to your wallet as soon as the payment confirms on-chain. You never touch a crypto exchange.
faq.a2: Directly in a wallet address you control — not held by us. Dynopay is non-custodial. Every settlement is a real on-chain transfer to your address.
faq.a3: Between 1.5% (Starter) and 0.5% (Enterprise), based on 30-day volume. No monthly fee, no setup fee, no chargebacks. See the Fees page for the full tier table.
faq.a4: It depends on the network. Stablecoin rails and fast chains (TRC-20, Polygon, L2s) usually confirm in a minute or two; Bitcoin and Ethereum mainnet can take longer when they're busy. Your dashboard shows live transaction status the whole way — and if you've turned on auto-convert, funds land in your chosen stablecoin the moment the payment confirms; otherwise you keep the coin the buyer sent.
faq.q5: Do you support fiat, refunds, or subscriptions?
faq.a5: Refunds, yes — one-click, on-chain reversals that send funds straight back to the buyer's address. We don't do fiat cards or auto-recurring subscriptions today: every charge is a direct, one-time crypto payment settled to a wallet you control, with optional auto-convert to USDC or USDT. Need a repeat payment? Just reshare the same link.
faq.a6: Yes. Share your referral link and when a merchant signs up you both get 50% off Dynopay fees for 30 days. Your friend's discount starts the moment they join; yours unlocks once they take their first payment.
